comment: Vanilla Impact natives (tools/impact survey; docs/re/impact.md). hash = FNV-1a-32(node); args in args[] order: args[0] is the LAST value pushed before ECALL. Evidence: [dis] the registerNative table and Kiln's decompiles; [data] the 571 vanilla programs.

natives.name: startQuery
natives.doc: Starts a sphere collision query of `range` around origin (+offset) and writes its QueryId; read it with getQueryResultCount / fetchQueryResult.

natives.name: stopQuery
natives.doc: Ends a query started with startQuery.

natives.name: getTransform
natives.doc: Writes the entity's world transform and/or its position (either output may be _).

natives.name: getBuffTarget
natives.doc: Writes the entity the running buff is applied to (a buff program runs on the buff's own entity).

natives.name: getSelf
natives.doc: Writes the entity that runs this program (the impact entity: projectile, AoE volume, buff).

natives.name: getParent
natives.doc: Writes the parent in the impact hierarchy (the entity that spawned this one); NoConnection (0x18) without an output.

natives.name: getEntityParent
natives.doc: Writes the hierarchy parent of `entity`.

natives.name: getRoot
natives.doc: Writes the root of the impact hierarchy: the caster (player or NPC) at the top of the spawn chain. Hits and XP are credited to it.

natives.name: getHitTarget
natives.doc: Writes the hit target of `entity` [hyp].

natives.name: getLockedTarget
natives.doc: Writes `entity`'s current target of the given ecs.TargetType (Combat = the lock-on / combat target).

natives.name: setHookTarget
natives.doc: Sets the grappling-hook target of `entity` [hyp from the name].

natives.name: getQueryResultCount
natives.doc: Writes the number of results of a query.

natives.name: fetchQueryResult
natives.doc: Writes result #index of a query: entity, hit position and normal, whether it hit and whether it is new.

natives.name: getOnCollisionEventCount
natives.doc: Writes the number of OnCollision events this step.

natives.name: fetchOnCollisionEvent
natives.returns: 1 while an element was fetched (the index variable is advanced), 0 at the end
natives.doc: Fetches OnCollision event #index with its other entity, root, collider kind, position, normal, material and whether it is a combat target.

natives.name: isValidEntity
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether the entity id refers to a live entity.

natives.name: isSameEntity
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether two entity ids are the same entity.

natives.name: isEnemy
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether b is an enemy of a (faction relations).

natives.name: isFriend
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether b is a friend of a (unused by vanilla programs).

natives.name: isDaytime
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether it is day in the world.

natives.name: isSprinting
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether the actor sprints.

natives.name: overrideTemplateBuildingFlyMode
natives.doc: Picks the override template when `entity` is in building fly mode, else `template` [hyp].

natives.name: getWeaponBaseDamage
natives.doc: Writes the base damage of the used weapon at its level.

natives.name: createDamageSetup
natives.doc: Builds an impact.DamageSetup from 13 values in its field order (cut, pierce, blunt, fire, ice, fog, lightning, healing, poison, wood, stone, metal, explosion); unconnected = 0.

natives.name: applyDamage
natives.returns: 1 when the hit landed (vanilla branches to its debuff code on it)
natives.doc: Deals `damage` from attacker to target: elements, the attacker's attributes (damageScaleAttribute), armour, block and crit (docs/re/combat.md), hit reaction, push-back and noise. The result is the hit landing; wasBlocked tells whether it was blocked.

natives.name: setAttribute
natives.doc: Sets an attribute of `entity` to value.

natives.name: applyAttributeValue
natives.doc: Applies a lasting modifier to an attribute (attribute op value) and keeps it per call site; RevertChange at the same site (in shutdown) removes it. Perks, buffs and skill nodes use the pair.

natives.name: changeAttributeValue

args.name: attribute
args.doc: AttributeReference; the attribute id is FNV-1a of its GUID

args.name: scratch
args.doc: receives the old value; same type as value

natives.returns: 1 on success, 0 when the entity has no such attribute
natives.doc: One-off change: attribute := attribute op value on `entity` (op = impact_nodes.ValuesMathOperator). Health (0x8eb84995), Stamina (0x04b6aa8b) and Mana (0x6aa2574e) changes are also reported as change events. Health is sint32.

natives.name: revertApplyAttributeValue
natives.doc: Removes the modifier ApplyChange added at the same call site (same arguments).

natives.name: fetchAttribute
natives.doc: Writes the entity's current attribute value (NotFound 0x11 when it has none).

natives.name: fetchOptionalAttribute
natives.returns: 1 when the entity has the attribute
natives.doc: Like fetchAttribute, without an error when the attribute is missing.

natives.name: add
natives.doc: result = a op b, typed by the variables (float32, sint32, Time, float3, ...). The four math natives share one function (0x190600): the op variable (impact_nodes.ValuesMathOperator: Add/Sub/Mul/Div) decides, so keep it matching the name (add).

natives.name: sub
natives.doc: result = a op b, typed by the variables (float32, sint32, Time, float3, ...). The four math natives share one function (0x190600): the op variable (impact_nodes.ValuesMathOperator: Add/Sub/Mul/Div) decides, so keep it matching the name (sub).

natives.name: mul
natives.doc: result = a op b, typed by the variables (float32, sint32, Time, float3, ...). The four math natives share one function (0x190600): the op variable (impact_nodes.ValuesMathOperator: Add/Sub/Mul/Div) decides, so keep it matching the name (mul).

natives.name: div
natives.doc: result = a op b, typed by the variables (float32, sint32, Time, float3, ...). The four math natives share one function (0x190600): the op variable (impact_nodes.ValuesMathOperator: Add/Sub/Mul/Div) decides, so keep it matching the name (div).

natives.name: clamp
natives.doc: result = value clamped to [min, max] [hyp: argument order from two vanilla uses].

natives.name: equal
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Compares a and b (typed by the variables). Shares its function with isLess: the op variable (ValuesCompareOperator Equal/Less) decides.

natives.name: less
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: a < b (typed). Shares its function with isEqual: the op variable decides.

natives.name: isInState
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether the actor has the state flag (actor.StateFlag: Grounded, Blocking, Dodging, InCombat, ...).

natives.name: hasFaction
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether the entity's faction is in the mask (optional second mask).

natives.name: hasAttackCategory
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether value has the categories of `contains` (all of them when matchAll).

natives.name: hasWeaponCategory
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether the weapon category is `required`.

natives.name: hasWeaponCategoryType
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether the weapon category's type is in the allowed mask.

natives.name: hasDamageType
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether value has the damage types of `contains` (all of them when matchAll).

natives.name: consumeItem
natives.doc: Consumes an item [hyp; unused by vanilla programs].

natives.name: applyOffset
natives.doc: result = transform moved by a local offset (in its orientation) and a world offset.

natives.name: spawnEntity
natives.doc: Spawns `template` at transform (or position) with velocity, under this program's impact hierarchy (owner/target/level/faction optional). The new entity runs its own Impact program: this is how projectiles spawn their explosions.

natives.name: applyBuff
natives.doc: Applies a BuffType to target for `lifetime` (unconnected: the buff's defaultLifeTime), optionally with a DamageSetup and an item. The buff is its own entity running the BuffType's program.

natives.name: hasBuff
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether the entity has the buff.

natives.name: removeBuff
natives.doc: Removes the buff from the entity.

natives.name: randomBranchNode
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Random branch: true with probability `chance` (0..1).

natives.name: randomValueNode
natives.doc: Writes a random float [hyp: 0..1].

natives.name: randomIndex
natives.doc: Writes a random index below count [hyp; unused by vanilla].

natives.name: triggerNoise
natives.doc: Emits an AI noise event (type 0xd079d101) at position with range, from the program's entity; NoConnection (0x18) when an input is unconnected.

natives.name: pacifyFaction
natives.doc: Pacifies a faction [hyp from the name].

natives.name: activateCallFactionForHelp
natives.doc: Makes the faction call for help [hyp from the name].

natives.name: forEachHitEvent
natives.returns: 1 while an element was fetched (the index variable is advanced), 0 at the end
natives.doc: Iterates the OnHit events this step (index = a uint32 the program zeroes first) and writes each hit's flags and entities.

natives.name: SendBaseHitEvent
natives.doc: Sends a basic hit event (target, position, normal, materials) without damage [hyp].

natives.name: SendRevivedPlayerEvent
natives.doc: Reports a revive (target revived by reviver).

natives.name: itemBasedMaterialReaction
natives.doc: Material feedback for a hit (sound/VFX by material, used item and ammunition).

natives.name: forEachParryEvent
natives.returns: 1 while an element was fetched (the index variable is advanced), 0 at the end
natives.doc: Iterates parry events (blocker, attacker).

natives.name: terraforming
natives.doc: Changes voxels at transform (remove/add/flatten, by impact.DamageTerraformingSetup per hardness). Canceled (6) when it does nothing.

natives.name: addWater
natives.doc: Adds water at transform.

natives.name: getCursorTransform
natives.doc: Writes the player's cursor (aim) transform.

natives.name: clearConsecutiveHits
natives.doc: Clears the consecutive-hit memory after an interval [hyp].

natives.name: isConsecutiveHit
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether the entity was hit before by this impact [hyp].

natives.name: GetConsecutiveHitCount
natives.doc: Writes the consecutive-hit count [hyp; unused by vanilla].

natives.name: GetEnemyCountInRange
natives.doc: Writes the number of enemies near the entity.

natives.name: IsSkillUnlocked
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether the player has the skill node.

natives.name: SetTransform
natives.doc: Moves the program's entity to transform.

natives.name: Normalize
natives.doc: Normalises a vector [hyp; unused by vanilla].

natives.name: SetLength
natives.doc: result = vector scaled to length.

natives.name: GetLength
natives.doc: result = length of vector.

natives.name: GetSlotTransform
natives.doc: Writes the transform/position of an attachment slot (HandR, Head, ...) of the entity.

natives.name: SetEnemyVariable
natives.doc: Sets an enemy AI variable (enemy01.EnemyVariableReference) on the entity.

natives.name: onEvent
natives.doc: Opens an event stream of the given type (OnCollision, OnHit, OnParry): writes eventStream {callId 0, type}. The program must allocate the stream (usedStreams).

natives.name: entityInRangeWithFaction
natives.doc: Opens an EntityInRange stream of entities with the factions within range of origin.

natives.name: forEachEntityInStream
natives.returns: 1 while an element was fetched (the index variable is advanced), 0 at the end
natives.doc: Iterates the entities of a stream.

natives.name: forEachHitEventInStream
natives.returns: 1 while an element was fetched (the index variable is advanced), 0 at the end
natives.doc: forEachHitEvent over a filtered stream (same outputs; the last argument is the stream).

natives.name: resetEntityStream
natives.doc: Empties a stream.

natives.name: isStreamEmpty
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether a stream has no events.

natives.name: forEachCollisionInStream
natives.returns: 1 while an element was fetched (the index variable is advanced), 0 at the end
natives.doc: Iterates the collision events of a stream (index = a uint32 the program zeroes first): other entity and root, position, normal, transform, material, combat-target flag.

natives.name: filterRandom
natives.doc: Writes a stream with the events of `input` that pass the Random filter (invert flips it).

natives.name: filterFriends
natives.doc: Writes a stream with the events of `input` that pass the Friends filter (invert flips it).

natives.name: filterSameRoot
natives.doc: Writes a stream with the events of `input` that pass the SameRoot filter (invert flips it).

natives.name: filterRootEntity
natives.doc: Writes a stream with the events of `input` that pass the RootEntity filter (invert flips it).

natives.name: filterFaction
natives.doc: Writes a stream with the events of `input` that pass the Faction filter (invert flips it).

natives.name: filterIsInState
natives.doc: Writes a stream with the events of `input` that pass the IsInState filter (invert flips it).

natives.name: filterConsecutiveHits
natives.doc: Writes a stream with the events of `input` that pass the ConsecutiveHits filter (invert flips it).

natives.name: filterEntityTag
natives.doc: Writes a stream with the events of `input` that pass the EntityTag filter (invert flips it).

natives.name: getStreamEventCount
natives.doc: Writes a stream's event count.

natives.name: forEachEntityWithFactionInRange

args.name: index
args.doc: uint32 counter, zero it before the loop

natives.returns: 1 while an element was fetched (the index variable is advanced), 0 at the end
natives.doc: Iterates the entities with the factions within range of origin. The query lives per call site (queryCallIds) and is released when the loop ends; destroyFactionQuery at the same site releases it early (vanilla calls it in shutdown). A range of 0 returns 0 at once.

natives.name: destroyFactionQuery
natives.doc: Releases the query of forEachEntityWithFactionInRange at the same site (same arguments).

natives.name: forEachPlayerInRange
natives.returns: 1 while an element was fetched (the index variable is advanced), 0 at the end
natives.doc: Iterates the players within range of origin (a per-site query like forEachEntityWithFactionInRange).

natives.name: destroyPlayerQuery
natives.doc: Releases the query of forEachPlayerInRange at the same site.

natives.name: getWeaponVisualEntityId
natives.doc: Writes the used weapon's visual entity.

natives.name: hasEntityTag
natives.returns: 1 = true, 0 = false (branch on it with brt/brf)
natives.doc: Whether the entity has the tag.

natives.name: triggerKnowledge
natives.doc: Unlocks knowledge (journal/recipes) for the entity's player.

natives.name: getCurseModifier
natives.doc: Writes the curse modifier [hyp from the name].

natives.name: destroyEntity
natives.doc: Destroys an entity. When the destroy request fails it returns Temporary_TimeOut (1): the ECALL suspends and runs again next step.

natives.name: getWaterChargeSize
natives.doc: Writes the water charge size [hyp from the name].

natives.name: fromTransform
natives.doc: Decomposes a transform relative to a reference (position, normal) [hyp].

natives.name: addSkillLevel
natives.doc: Adds a level of a skill node to the player; RevertAddSkillLevel at the same site removes it.

natives.name: revertaddSkillLevel
natives.doc: Reverts addSkillLevel (same site).

natives.name: debugDraw
natives.doc: Registered with a null function: the interpreter pushes 1 and does nothing (debug builds only).

natives.name: debugDrawCross
natives.doc: Registered with a null function: the interpreter pushes 1 and does nothing (debug builds only).

natives.name: debugDrawArrow
natives.doc: Registered with a null function: the interpreter pushes 1 and does nothing (debug builds only).
